annotations.title: Founders only: create a draft of your own startup pitch on PitchSpark

description: Founders: create a draft pitch on your own PitchSpark account from five facts. The draft is not listed, searchable or scored until the founder completes it and submits it for review in Pitch Studio at the returned edit_url. Needs a founder submit token (pss_..., from PitchSpark Settings). OAuth pitches:submit also works.

problem_statement.description: One paragraph on the problem and who has it; the first sentence becomes the tagline.
